byte_policy: Every retained byte and every original metadata entry are rechecked directly against the archive. Corpus inputs are not copied into this repository.

preparer_reuse.original: accepted standalone prepare_manifest.py for this exact pin
preparer_reuse.copy_policy: Implementation is byte-identical to the accepted preparer; tests adapt imports, explicit TMPDIR and optional real-header fixture location only.

harness_include_policy: sta.js contains the definitions for all six observed include names; original $INCLUDE is a no-op. environment.js, Date_constants.js and Date_library.js are empty. math_precision.js, math_isequal.js and numeric_conversion.js are older standalone implementations and are not additionally evaluated.
negative_policy: Historical @negative values are optional error-text patterns, not phase declarations. No filename or SyntaxError-based phase inference. No negative passes without reviewed typed case-origin diagnostic authority.
native_policy: Deferred without reviewed real SSA, useful instruction counts and lowering evidence; no generic count, AOT entry or fallback acceptance.
